title: Put identity.searchTitle (Desarrollador Full Stack) first wherever a machine or a search reads the title; brandTitle (Product Engineer) only after it
body: Two identities that do not mix: `searchTitle` = `Desarrollador Full Stack`, what recruiters type into Computrabajo, Bumeran or LinkedIn Recruiter; `brandTitle` = `Product Engineer` ("I build complete web products, not screens"), for About, portfolio and conversation. In LatAm nobody searches for "Product Engineer", so the searchable title starts the chain and the brand comes after: putting the brand first gains character and loses appearances, and with freelance + local market appearances are the asset. Apply it to <title> tags, the CV header, JSON-LD `jobTitle`, /llms.txt, the OG card and the hero meta line (src/pages/v2.astro included). Do not swap the order or replace searchTitle with brandTitle for style.
not_derivable: jsonld.test only pins jobTitle; the market reason, and that the order is a rule for every surface rather than a per-file choice, is nowhere in code.
